name: rcmdsh
description: Control any command prompt on your computer from your phone

scripts.build: npm run build -w rcmdsh-core && npm run build -w rcmdsh && npm run build -w rcmdsh-relay && npm run build -w @rcmdsh/web && node scripts/copy-web-dist.mjs
scripts.build:node: npm run build -w rcmdsh-core && npm run build -w rcmdsh && npm run build -w rcmdsh-relay
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/daemon && tsc --noEmit -p packages/relay
